note: Built by scripts/recheck_plan.py from repo data only. Read-only plan for future automations; never a reason to skip an official recheck.

global.check: Smartraveller advice level and 'latest update' for every destination
global.why: Levels can change overnight after conflict, unrest or disaster.

global.check: What an Australian may do on each entry route (tourism, meetings, speaking, remote work)
global.why: Work rules are the most common 'confirm in writing' gap.

global.check: Public affection, relationships, LGBTQIA+ law
global.why: Law reforms happen in both directions.

global.check: Australian embassy or consulate and its contact details
global.why: Missions open, close or suspend services.

global.check: Visa-free status, max stay, arrival cards and refusals for an ordinary Australian passport
global.source: Destination immigration authority or embassy in Australia; Smartraveller entry section
global.why: Waivers and exemptions are often time-limited (China, South Korea, Belarus) or cut at short notice (Thailand, Sep 2026).

global.check: Vaccination certificates (yellow fever), health declarations, outbreak rules
global.source: Destination health authority; Smartraveller health section; WHO
global.why: Outbreaks add requirements quickly.

global.check: Laws that catch visitors: ID, photography, dress, LGBTQIA+, alcohol
global.source: The level's own legislation; Smartraveller local laws
global.why: Laws stack from country to state to city.

global.check: Currency, cash limits, card acceptance, tourist taxes
global.why: Rates move daily but rules (cash limits, tourist taxes) change slowly.

global.check: Alcohol, cannabis, psilocybin, prescription medicines
global.source: Legislation and health regulator; Smartraveller drugs section
global.why: Several programs have start dates (e.g. New Mexico psilocybin).

global.check: Visa fees, e-visa portals, processing times, documents
global.why: Fees and portals change with little notice; atlas baselines must be rechecked.

global.check: Elections, major events and dated rule changes in the next 12 months
global.why: Organisers announce next year's dates on known months; elections get called.

global.check: Permits for restricted areas, land councils, parks, island governments, border zones
global.why: Permit lead times decide when the approach phase starts.

global.check: Access, tickets, permits, diving rules and heritage-law protection at ancient, underground and underwater sites
global.source: UNESCO World Heritage Centre; national heritage or antiquities authorities; site and park authorities
global.why: Opening, ticket caps and closures change; lore stays labelled as claims.

global.check: Australian law and guidance that applies to Australians overseas
global.source: Commonwealth agency pages (DFAT, ABF, DAFF, ATO, Services Australia, AEC, AFP, AGD, Defence)
global.why: Rules and thresholds change.

global.check: Is there an official register or search tool of certified drone operators here, what licence or certificate must a commercial operator hold, can a foreign visitor fly commercially or must they hire a local operator, and what legal routes exist to existing aerial footage?
global.source: the national aviation authority (for example CASA, CAA, FAA, Transport Canada, MLIT, EASA and national authorities); state, park or council permit offices; national tourism boards' and film commissions' own media libraries

global.check: Birth rates and family support
global.why: Annual data releases.

global.check: Etiquette, respecting Country, community visitor guidance
global.why: Slow-changing.

global.check: Public holidays, Ramadan and Islamic months, lunar new year, festivals
global.source: National calendars; Nager.Date as a signal
global.why: Lunar and Islamic calendars move every year; next year's holidays are often announced late in the year.

global.check: Official and widely spoken languages
global.why: Very slow-changing.

global.check: Weather seasons, crowds, cyclone and monsoon windows
global.why: Slow-changing, but check before a trip.

global.check: Luke's own work tie-ins (venues, partners, events)
global.why: Tagged places only.

global_extra.check: ETIAS and EES rollout (Schengen and EU)
global_extra.why: Start date not settled; watch item eu-etias (check every 30 days).

global_extra.check: Official source pages still alive (hash and 404 check)
global_extra.why: A changed hash flags a page to reread; a failed fetch is not evidence of a rule change.

global_extra.check: Next year's public holidays file (data/calendar/holidays-<next year>.json)
global_extra.why: Governments publish next year's holiday lists late in the year; Islamic dates are confirmed by moon sighting nearer the time.
